ranked_hypotheses.title: Crustal Seismogenic-Hydrothermal-Piedmont Dual-Cover Conduit Detection (ANSS ComCat 1900-2026 Hypocenters + Post-2021 Lineaments + GDR #1391 Blind Cold-Spring Geothermometer Disequilibrium + Seamless 10m 3DEP Piedmont-Chi)

topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif (100% seamless USGS 3DEP 10 m slope, planform curvature, fluvial chi)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Depth-weighted brittle-crust (1.5-15 km) hypocenter kernel density + post-2021 local covariance-eigenvector fault-strike lineament bridge + blind cold-discharge silica/cation geothermometer disequilibrium (Delta_T = max(T_SiO2, T_NaKCa) - T_meas > 40 deg C for T_meas < 45 deg C) + MT clay-cap / contractor-standardized 214Bi radon upflow + seamless 10 m piedmont apron scarp & valley-exit fluvial chi x harmonic basement gravity concordance + dilatational/shear strain reactivation index, combined inside a stationary 97-ch/84-ch Dual-Cover OOF ensemble with cross-term-free Bayesian two-population envelope max(R(P_cont)^6, 0.834 * R(P_blind)^6) and axial d_min = 3.62 px CELF emission.
ranked_hypotheses.why_catches_missing_faults: Directly resolves three blind-fault populations missed by the 2021 INGENIOUS compilation: (1) post-2021 microearthquake fault planes invisible in Band 10/16; (2) blind geothermal systems masked by shallow cold alluvial aquifers (e.g., McGinness Hills, Tungsten Mountain, Dixie Comstock) where T_meas < 45 deg C but quartz/chalcedony geothermometers retain >85-180 deg C deep reservoir equilibrium; and (3) unmapped scarps inside the 24.63% NW/NE 1 m LiDAR gap via 100%-seamless 10 m 3DEP piedmont-chi.
named_non_fault_mimics: Mesozoic/Paleozoic intrarange bedrock thrusts & high-mountain drainage-divide chi jumps (slope > 14 deg, depth_to_base < 80 m; suppressed by piedmont-apron envelope + harmonic basement gravity gate)
Closed-basin desert salt playas (depth > 300 m, slope < 2 deg; <0.03% dots via zero-anchored playa veto) & Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (~1,332 m) shoreline benches
US BLM MLRS mining-pit blasts (earthquake-only ComCat filter) & 4-contractor GeoDAWN radiometric block seams
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_existing_repo: Zero prior submissions in ApartGEMSDOE3 or any of the 9 focus / sibling repos used usgs_comcat_geodawn.csv post-2021 fault-strike lineaments, gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv blind cold-discharge chemical geothermometer disequilibrium (strictly dropping dist_known_fault_px), or axial sqrt(13) (d_min = 3.62 px) two-population envelope max(R(P_cont)^6, beta * R(P_blind)^6).
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_vs_cost: Rank #1 — HIGH expected DTI gain (+0.009 to +0.010 simultaneously on BOTH Hide-and-Recover v3.0 and Off-Catalogue SGMC-cal v3.0 with both 95% paired CIs > 0) at LOW-MODERATE CPU/RAM cost (<300 MB anonymous heap).

Oligocene-Miocene caldera ring-fracture margins (closed circular planform)

ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_vs_cost: Rank #3 — MEDIUM gain (+0.002 to +0.004) at MODERATE FFT memory cost; reserved for future iteration outside the 3-experiment budget.
